title: [OOS]: Endless Enderman
description: This pack uses OptiFine to add in new Enderman varients.
body:
# [OOS]: Endless Enderman
### (Part of the "Optimal OptiFine Series)

I'll be honest with you. Enderman are awesome, but they could be cooler. They should definitely have biome varients.

Well, that's what this is for. Using either the OptiFine loader or ETF + EMF, and this pack, you should begin seeing new Enderman varients in your world.

In the zip file, please ignore the Loader_info.txt, and:
please look at the REMIX_NOTES.txt

**BTW, if we can get my "Bake your Bread" data pack to 15 downloads, I will add 10 more Enderman varients to this. We currently have 12 varients:
https://modrinth.com/datapack/bake-your-bread-nightml**

## Created by NightML, aka NightMareLore. 

Taking suggestions for varients via email: nightmarelore.10@gmail.com

Please enjoy! But, don't feel inclined to download it, if it isn't your style.
Though there is no active content, music videos will be eventually uploaded to **@NightMareLore10** on YouTube. [Please subscribe for more updates - completely free!]

## Will Likely Update Fairly Often (as of September 28, 2025)

P.S. I try my very best to ensure that all of my content is family friendly and respectful to all culture, race, religion, and other personal factors. If anyone at any point finds something to be disrespectful or non-family friendly, then you can contact me at nightmarelore.10@gmail.com. If I personally find that my content is disrespectful in any manner, then I will **_IMMEDIATELY_** change it to ensure that my community is a safe, kind, healthy, and supportive one!
